snippet.title: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department) | Official Lauch Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4914590/ADD_Anomaly_Detection_Department/

Welcome to A.D.D.

A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department) is a card-based strategy and management game where players take on the role of a manager who deploys employees into unknown areas and oversees the expeditions conducted for a company.

Deploy employees, connect nodes across the board, and design exploration routes. Organize the records and byproducts recovered from expeditions, refine them into the required data, and submit the results demanded by the company.

Manage the limited space on your board as employees, records, data, and nodes continue to accumulate. Decide what to preserve, what to discard, and where your loyalty lies.

Explore.
Refine.
Submit.

Meet the quota.
Pick your side.

A.D.D. will be available for free on Steam on July 31, 2026.

Developed by ONE MORE SPOON.

Music by Tunetank from Pixabay:
https://pixabay.com/ko/users/tunetank-50201703/?utm_source=link-attribution&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=music&utm_content=347619
